SCE.S:B6054: Works at my office. Mother is from Hong Kong. Good at moving fast.
SCE.S:B6120: My school friend. Does "space-time" research on his father's money. The government watches it.
SCE.S:B61EC: Since the "anomaly" its brain has swelled fast. It has begun to gain telepathic powers.
SCE.S:B62B8: Fairly gentle. Can't talk yet. Loves running by the sea.
SCE.S:B6384: Sworn to "guard the plant," she stayed loyal even after the "anomaly."
SCE.S:B6450: Honest 24-year man. Off sick when the "anomaly" hit. Favorite word: "fellowship."
SCE.S:B651C: "Electricity nut." Loves glowing, crackling things. Favorite food: curry rice.
SCE.S:B65E8: The plant's first "victim." Outdoorsy; climbs with friends on days off. Went north to the peaks the day before.
SCE.S:B66B4: Top engineer at the plant. Only hobby: tinkering. At 7 he invented an automatic lawnmower.
SCE.S:B6780: Greedy. Would betray the pack for food. Loves dog food. Doesn't get along with fellow guard dog Watt.
SCE.S:B684C: The first Doberman to split her "instinct" from her "substance." Favorite food: raw beef.
SCE.S:B6918: Always looked down on his kind. Now he hopes, baselessly, to evolve into another "race."
SCE.S:B69E4: Suzuki's right-hand man. Suzuki took him to the mine just before the "anomaly"; he can't remember it.
SCE.S:B6AB0: New hire this spring. Lives with his parents and two sisters near the sea. Hobby: motorcyling.
SCE.S:B6B7C: One of the oldest guard dogs. Happy he can go inside the plant now.
SCE.S:B6C48: Leader of the plant's guard dogs. Loves chasing small, fast animals. Her fangs never miss.
SCE.S:B6D14: Sent by a private security firm. Knows the plant's layout best of all. His head is badly deformed.
SCE.S:B6DE0: Born here after the "anomaly" and grown in days. A pure mutant breed, she lives in a world of energy.

How did you get in here?!

SCE.S:E786C: My coworkers are back to normal. What was going on?
SCE.S:E797C: The first to turn strange was Suzuki. He went to the mountains on his vacation... he must have seen It.
SCE.S:E7A30: Mr. Suzuki took me to the coal mine. He's been gone ever since.
SCE.S:EA310: You're the newspaper reporter who came by before. Things have been going well lately.
SCE.S:EA41C: Actually, I'm the one who built the device in the basement. At the time, I thought I was doing something good.
SCE.S:EA4E8: When I remember the time I wasn't myself, I get kind of excited.
SCE.S:ED01C: {6}MY BRAIN HAS GROWN SO BIG... WALKING ON FOUR LEGS IS GETTING HARD.
SCE.S:ED0C8: {6}I FEEL VERY... PLEASANT. ALL SORTS OF CONCEPTS ARE FLOWING IN.
SCE.S:ED170: So you're one of them too!
SCE.S:ED1F4: {6}Power and energy itself... carries a message of its own.
SCE.S:ED2A0: {6}There are still those in the "City" who refuse to cooperate. Once they live on "my" electricity, they too will change their "thinking".
SCE.S:ED380: {6}Did you see the device under the power plant? It is called the "World System".
SCE.S:ED430: {6}I CRAVE MEAT... DESPERATELY. A HABIT BURNED DEEP INTO THIS "BODY".
SCE.S:ED564: {6}I can see rainbow light spilling from the {7}power plant{6}. That is "electricity".
SCE.S:ED610: {6}Every day I bathe in 100,000 watts of electricity. I can feel my "body" changing.
